items.sentence: The MHRA says domperidone is now contraindicated in confirmed or suspected phaeochromocytoma because of a risk of severe hypertension.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA published a Drug Safety Update on 21 July 2026 about domperidone.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: Domperidone is now contraindicated in patients with confirmed or suspected phaeochromocytoma.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The reason is a risk of severe hypertension (very high blood pressure).
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA had received no UK Yellow Card reports of this event.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA says a recent European review of safety data identified an association between domperidone and episodes of severe hypertension in patients with phaeochromocytoma, after a small number of reports.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: Phaeochromocytoma is a rare tumour of the adrenal gland.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: As a result, domperidone is now contraindicated in patients with confirmed or suspected phaeochromocytoma, which means it should not be used in them.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA tells prescribers that patients with confirmed or suspected phaeochromocytoma who are taking domperidone should have treatment stopped and be switched to an alternative.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: It adds that domperidone can unmask the tumour, so a severe hypertensive episode in someone taking it should prompt consideration of further investigation.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA says it has not received any UK Yellow Card reports of severe hypertension with domperidone in patients with phaeochromocytoma, and asks that suspected side effects be reported through the Yellow Card scheme.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: Anyone with questions about their own treatment can ask the prescriber or pharmacist.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.
